Job Title: Java Developer 
 Location: Lansing, MI 
 Duration: 1 Year 
 Visa- GC or US Citizen 
 Job Description: 
 
 Specific skills required: Web Services Development 5+ years of experience in the following: 
 Experience in JEE development
 Experience in implementing JPA using Hibernate
 Extensive experience in developing XML Schemas
 Extensive experience in developed JAX WS Web Services
 Experience in developing Security for Web Services
 Experience in consuming/producing Web Services for an application
 Experience in JUnit/SOAP UI testing
 
 General skills required:  7+ years development experience in the following areas: 
 
 Skills Required 
 J2EE, Java 5.0, EJB
 JSP and Servlets
 SQL
 Struts, Struts 2
 Hibernate
 Spring
 Web Services
 JavaScript
 XML
 Custom Tags
 JDBC
 Multi-Threading
 HTML
 J-Query
 AJAX
 LDAP using Active Directory or Tivoli
  
 Experience Preferred 
 Health care
 Healthcare Insurance
 Experience with HIPAA (4010/5010), EDI (834)
 Knowledge of health care eligibility, online enrollment. Retirement Area
 Retirement and Benefit Estimation
 Experience working in Public Retirement systems.
 Knowledge of generating benefit estimate Finance and Payments
 Accounting principles
 Understanding the general ledger
 Knowledge in GAAP (Generally accepted accounting principles),
 Cash receipts, Cash reconciliation, Account payables, Account receivables,
 Invoice, Billing, revenue\expense recording, cash allocation, payment processing, general ledger entries
 Reporting requirement for 401k and 457 plans
 History with Pension Plans
 Reporting requirements for pension plans
